commits_info.message: pre-release version bump
Changed the lombok.nonNull.exceptionType configkey to be an enum, partly to enforce only sensible exceptions and partly to make it possible to have the message be ‘x is null’ when throwing IAEs.
Added confkey to make @NonNull generate a different exception because of the IllegalArgumentException vs. NullPointerException that we really don’t want to get into.
[trivial] removed possible warning in eclipse.
added documentation for the configuration feature.
added conf keys (and implementation to make them work) for lombok.getter.lazy.flagUsage and lombok.equalsAndHashCode.doNotUseGetters.
upgraded to lombok.patcher 1.15 to fix bug 670.
Suppressed warning about 'ignoreAllErrors()' that was added to IErrorHandlingPolicy in a more recent ecj editions
New year in documentation
Issue 676: Updated the video player code, removed all Quicktime references.
Fix website re. Delegate
added a test and handler for correctly handling confkey: lombok.delegate.flagUsage.
Added an error if @Delegate is used recursively.

@Delegate has moved to lombok.experimental.

Some work on the aliasing system to make that go smoothly.
patcher upgrade for issue 666.
We closed one tag too many on the homepage. Apparently on some modern version of firefox this makes flash confused.
Added test for issue 361. It is currently ignored.
[java8] Added tests for using java language features in transformations.
[java8] don't crash on intersection types

All tests now succeed on all platforms again;
'optional' expected messages added.
expanded some tests.
Added a check if the bootclasspath supports a certain version, i.e. don't try to run a JDK7-only test if AutoClosable isn't available.

bugfix: our new trick to try and disable target typing by making the LHS of a 'val' statement be of an unknown type instead of j.l.Object works for Javac8, but breaks Javac6! We now detect this and pick the right strategy based on whether or not the compiler supports target typing.
Our maven/ivy instructions also apply to gradle; updated docs to reflect this.
[website] tweaked and reworded contributed instructions for gradle and Android Studio for the website.
Merge branch 'patch-1' of https://github.com/dodgex/lombok into dodgex-patch-androiddocs

Update android.html

`apt` is only required when using android-apt plugin

Update android.html

added info about @java.beans.ConstructorProperties
Add Android Studio / Gradle instructions
bugfix for errors with ecj8 and builder.

some pretty significant changes to the build system, to try and add testing against ecj8 to the lineup, and to force compilation with the bootstrap classpath of JDK6 so that we won't accidentally add deps on things that JVM6es don't have.

eclipse usually just wants 'null' instead of a zero-len array.

In this particular case, ecj8 (but not ecj7) would start printing extra
spaces, causing tests to fail. Other things tend to break too, so,
we're sticking to the 'null for empty arrays' model.
[java8] Support in delombok for intersection typecast and lambdas
Changed whitespace
[test harness] Java 7+ tests would not be triggered using java 8
added docs for the new onParam feature on EqualsAndHashCode, and some tiny stylistic nitpicking.
Fixed tests, added test for ecj.
Fixing possible NPE
Adde my name to the Authors list.
Adding eclipse support.
Adding onParam to annotation @EqualsAndHashCode to add individual annotations to the parameters of equals and canEqual.
[#655] Switched to ASM5 to support -target 1.8 classes.
[#655] Added a test for the post compiler. It indeed fails in JDK8 now due to an ASM version that doesn't understand java 8 class files.
all usage of sneakyThrow is now throw sneakyThrow as it should be.
Added issue number to changelog
[i659] suppression of @ConstructorProperties should use config instead. Also modified all onX examples to use two underscores.

[i660] canEqual is now protected instead of public.

Also fixed the total lack of canEqual in the usage examples.

post release version bump

removed unused code

[configuration] Merge branch 'master' as we work on configuration.

* Conflict due to adding topic() feature to logger in master, and 'field name' feature in config branch.
* master has since updated to shiny new eclipse dep versions and the 'ant eclipseForDebugging' feature, but this branch added deps. Addressed that.
* Renamed 'loggerCategory' to 'loggerTopic'. I know, that wasn't exactly right to do in a merge, but, there you have it.
* Test infrastructure changed in configuration branch, and tests had been added in master branch.

[configuration] Added the configuration keys lombok.ToString.doNotUseGetters and lombok.ToString.includeFieldNames
[configuration] Have the ConfigurationApp print platform-specific newLine characters, and print clear for empty lists.
[configuration] Added first automated test for the configuration framework. For now, it fails.
[configuration] Small improvements to the command line app

[configuration] Extended the configuration app to display the resulting configuration for a path and have 'blame'. Removed the PrintConfiguration annotation and handlers. Separated the parsing and the interpreting.
[configuration] Copy less lists during resolving
[configuration] Code cleanup
[configuration] Improved descriptions of configuration keys

[test] Missing after-X files used to be an implicit 'just ignore the content' signal; now you need an explicit directive to allow this behaviour.
[configuration] added tests for @Accessors configuration key implementations.
[configuration] ConfigurationKeysLoader now caches.

[configuration] Added all the @Accessors stuff as a configuration key.
[refactor] Merged TransformationsUtil and HandlerUtil
[configuration] ConfigurationKey now has a description
[configuration] added a service-loader based way to load ConfigurationKeys, so that third party additions can add their own.
[trivial] added test for logger config keys.

[configuration] added facilities to override conf file resolution for test cases, and added first tests to test implementations of configuration-based stuff (FlagUsages, specifically). Error reporter has been refactored.
[configuration] Initial setup for configuration app
[configuration] Move the responsibility to stop bubbling to the iterator
[configuration] only allow a keyname to be registered once
[configuration] Make sure the ConfigurationKeys class is initialized
[configuration] Moved ALL ConfigurationKey constants into 'ConfigurationKeys'; that bug where fields in annotation defs causes issues is too endemic to try and work around these.
[configuration] The 'getAbsoluteFileLocation()' addition to EclipseAST did not work in ECJ; now it does.
[configuration] [snippet] Removed the 'getProject' method; this doesn't even exist on ECJ.

[test-directives] another update to the 'test directives' system; test files now can start with directives (configuration keys, 'ignore', and java language version limits), and the test directory runner now has a framework to handle these. All existing tests pass at this point.
Moved NonNull's FLAG_USAGE ConfigurationKey definition to ConfigurationKeys to work around bugs with putting fields in annotation declarations in many versions of JDK7 and all of JDK6's versions.
[configuration] updates to the tests to streamline parsing 'directives', which have become more important as input files now may need to set up some lombok configuration stuff.
[configuration] implementations for log's log.any.fieldIsStatic config.
[configuration] implementation of flagUsage for all handlers.

[configuration] Reduced the range around which all already flagged errors/warnings are removed (javac/delombok only) when using onMethod / onConstructor / onParam. Useful for adding warnings such as lombok configuration 'flag usages'.
[configuration] initial batch of configuration keys, primarily for flag usages.
compiling lombok with javac gives 1 warning. fixed this.
[configuration] Removed type parameter from ConfigurationSource.Result

[configuration] More strict naming rules for keyNames:
- may contain letters, digits, minus signs, underscores and periods
- must start with a letter, minus sign or underscore
- may not end with a period or minus sign

the rules about the periods are for possible future wildcard/globbing enhancements
Close the outputstream if it is a file after printing the AST
[configuration] Added @PrintConfiguration to print the combined interpreted configuration for a certain java file, improved problem reporting
[configuration] Implement LombokConfiguration (using the CONSOLE error reporter)
[configuration] Pass the ConfigurationErrorReporterFactory as a parameter instead of a field.
[configuration] Use URI in the API instead of files. Null results in an empty Iterable. Some improvements on the time-out code
[configuration] Use the file system to look for 'lombok.config' files and parse those and cache the results
[configuration] Add option 'stop-bubbling=true' to a lombok.config file to prevent the system from going up the directory tree to find more config files
[configuration] Bubbling now works
[configuration] Implemented the StringResolver
[configuration] ongoing work on the typing and resolving
[configuration] Initial API for declaring ans reading single settings.

[configuration] Added the .getAbsoluteFileLocation() method to AST;
this now works properly (even with eclipse Linked Resources) in both
eclipse and javac. We will now use this feature to search for and apply
config files, which will apply hierarchically based on the directory of
the source file.
work in progress on ProjectSearcher.
Fixed missing dep resolution for ecj variants used by testing.
more work on JDK8 support: val on generified lub types now works a little better.
LoggerSlf4jOnNonType test just cares about error messages, so now the actual source output is just ignored as irrelevant.
added a new 'master' javac8 as the basis for Oracle8 testing, and included sources for this to aid in debugging.
added support for different error messages, where either one will mean the tests pass (new versions of javac, ecj, etc sometimes totally change the message).

thoroughly updated the launch targets for testing lombok in eclipse;
they should now be able to handle running JDK8 etc tests.

CAREFUL: You MUST name your JDK8 'JavaSE-1.8' or it won't work.

Also added a basic test for JDK8 features.
[java8] Support in delombok for default methods in interfaces
[java8] Support in delombok for method references.
